label: preparing
what: An evening community hospitality gathering in the great hall at eighteen, with lanterns and a large paid bread catering order. Innkeeper and builder supplied bread and coordinated arrangements; baker supplies the bread and freight assists delivery. Initially the preparations and occasion were not explained to me; I have now been invited, with the programme to be announced at eighteen. Secretary is helping schedule my attendance and escort, but no evidence establishes secretary or neighbour as original organisers.
